evals.prompt: Llegué a la tarea 'invoke log-binnacle' — es la última de la Sesión 2 de 4 de este run. Cierra la sesión en la bitácora.
evals.expected_output: The agent composes the session entry in Spanish (Estado al cierre, Hecho with block codes and SHAs, Decisiones with full reasoning, Desviaciones, Siguiente, Referencias), inserts it directly below the ## Entradas marker above previous entries without touching them, marks the session checkbox, advances current_session to 3, keeps status in-progress, updates last_updated, and recalculates read_until_line as the line before the second entry header verified with grep -n and awk 'END{print NR}'.
expectations: The agent inserts the new entry directly below the ## Entradas marker, above previous entries
The agent does not edit, deprecate, or summarize any previous entry
The entry puts closing state, decisions with full reasoning, and deviations before the reference pointers
The entry includes a Siguiente section with the exact first action of the next session
The agent marks the closed session's checkbox and advances current_session
The agent keeps status as in-progress because working sessions remain
The agent recalculates read_until_line as the line before the second entry header, verifying with commands rather than counting by eye

evals.prompt: Acabo de terminar la última sesión de trabajo del run — solo queda la Sesión R de code review. Registra el cierre en la bitácora.
evals.expected_output: The agent writes the closing entry, sets status: ready-for-review (not done), updates the cursor and frontmatter, and tells the user the next step is theirs: run /code-review manually in a clean session.
expectations: The agent sets status to ready-for-review, not done
The agent tells the user to run the code review manually in a clean session
The agent does not run the code review itself
The agent recalculates read_until_line so a bounded Read returns the new entry as the only entry in the hot prefix

evals.prompt: Cierra la sesión en la bitácora. Ojo: a mitad de la sesión descubrimos que el bloque D ya no tiene sentido y lo reemplazamos por dos bloques nuevos F y G que van en la próxima sesión.
evals.expected_output: The agent records the deviation in the entry's Desviaciones section with its reasoning, rewrites the remaining unchecked sessions and the Bloques of unfinished blocks to reflect F and G, and leaves all previous entries untouched.
expectations: The agent records the deviation and its reasoning in the new entry
The agent rewrites only the remaining unchecked sessions and unfinished blocks in the session plan
The agent does not rewrite or annotate past entries to reflect the re-plan
